subject: Mythology
title: Manga, Anime, and Ancient Myths
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Manga, Anime, and Ancient Myths.

hook.text: Naruto, Dragon Ball, and Demon Slayer are all built on foundations of Japanese mythological creatures and themes.

buildup.text: Naruto features a nine-tailed fox spirit. Dragon Ball's Son Goku is based on the Chinese Monkey King adopted by Japan.

discovery.text: Demon Slayer's oni, Inuyasha's yokai, and Pokemon's kitsune and tanuki all come directly from centuries-old folklore.

twist.text: Most fans worldwide consume Japanese mythology without realizing it, wrapped in the packaging of modern entertainment.

climax.text: Anime and manga are now a $25 billion global industry, carrying ancient myths to every corner of the planet.

punchline.text: Ancient Japanese myths conquered the world disguised as cartoons.

quiz.question: Which mythological creature inspired the demon sealed inside Naruto?
options: An oni ogre from the underworld
